|translation='''Title:''' Evacuation Control.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on your strategic command room or battle command post. Once per turn, your Planet Defender Ion Cannon at the same planet may fire during your move phase. Each of your medium transports at the same planet is hyperspeed +2 and immune to attrition less than 3. They may move without spending Force.

'''Lore:'''
Issue the withdrawal order to all forces… and you get on a transport quickly too!

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' War rooms print as 戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所.
